name: minsc & boo
lore:
To encounter the Rashemaar ranger Minsc is to witness a singular symbiotic anomaly. Standing as a mountain of scarred muscle, the man possesses a temperament both childlike and ferocious. Yet, he is but the vessel. Tucked within his tunic dwells Boo, a creature of diminutive stature but purported cosmic significance: a Miniature Giant Space Hamster.

Their ecology is defined by kinetic righteousness. They do not hunt for sustenance so much as they track the scent of "Evil," a quarry they pursue with unrelenting fervor. In battle, their behavior is rhythmic: Minsc provides the thunderous force, while Boo serves as the tactical pilot from his shoulder. Note the rodent’s keen, judgmental gaze; many veterans swear the hamster directs the man’s blade. Approach with caution—or better yet, a handful of sunflower seeds and a villain to smite. For where the hamster points, the ranger’s fury follows.
